Our story

Our Story

Moving a pet should be handled with the same care, safety, and operational precision as moving family.

Global Pet Cab was founded on a simple principle: moving a pet should be handled with the same care, safety, and operational precision as moving family.

Recognizing the unique mobility needs of Dubai's pet parent community, we expanded our operations to offer dedicated local city rides (Dubai Pet Taxi) alongside our established international pet relocation capabilities.

Today we are a dedicated pet mobility platform in Dubai — instant distance-based pet taxi fares across the city, and international pet relocation from Dubai to the world and world to Dubai.

Why we exist

Mission & Vision

Mission

To move every pet with the same care, safety, and operational precision as moving family — whether that is a climate-controlled ride across Dubai or a full international relocation with MOCCAE permits, IATA crates, and customs clearance.

Vision

To be Dubai's most trusted dedicated pet mobility platform — the team pet parents call first to connect homes, veterinary centres, and worldwide destinations, with warmth and logistics rigor in equal measure.

The people

Our Team

One unified team in Dubai — handlers, drivers, relocation specialists, and dispatch.

Certified Pet Handlers

Trained staff experienced in handling anxious pets, brachycephalic breeds, and multi-pet families.

Dubai Fleet Drivers

Trained drivers on climate-controlled vehicles, anti-slip flooring, and doorstep pickup across Dubai districts.

Relocation Specialists

The team that manages MOCCAE permits, IATA crates, airline approvals, and customs clearance.

WhatsApp Dispatch

Real people who share live updates throughout your pet’s ride — so you are never left wondering.

Wherever you're moving, your pet gets there safely.
